title: Anthropic and Infosys build AI agents \ Anthropic
summary: Anthropic and Infosys announced a collaboration to build enterprise AI agents for telecommunications, financial services, manufacturing and software development, integrating Claude models and Claude Code with Infosys Topaz. The page describes industry-specific agents, such as processing claims and managing compliance reviews, and says the agents work persistently across long, complex tasks.
evidence: Using tools like the Claude Agent SDK, Infosys and Anthropic will help clients build AI agents that work persistently across long, complex tasks and processes.

fields.autonomy_cues: systems that go beyond answering questions to independently handling multi-step tasks like processing claims, generating and testing code, or managing compliance reviews
